|printed_lore=''<span lang="ja">ヤヴィンの戦いでジェック・ポーキンズが搭乗したＸウイング。デス・スター攻撃に使用された。コンピュータと飛行システムの最終点検を受けていない。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
|translation='''Title:''' Red 6.

'''Card text:'''
May add 1 pilot. When A Problem Occurred is used against Red 6, the opponent may add 2 to destiny. Without a pilot, power, maneuver, and hyperspeed cannot be used.

'''Lore:'''
X-wing that Jek Porkins flew at the Battle of Yavin. It was used in the Death Star attack. It did not receive the final inspection of its computer and flight systems.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Japanese lore says the X-wing was used in the Death Star attack, not that it was instrumental in strafing success.
